integrationGuide.title: Card Store Integration Guide
integrationGuide.intro: Already run a Dujiao or ACG card store? Use this site as your upstream supplier. Pre-fund your purchasing balance, then automatically deduct the reseller cost, place the upstream order, and return the delivery content when a customer orders from your store.

noStore.title: No card store yet
noStore.text: Apply for a white-label subsite. The main platform handles hosting, upstream suppliers, and payments; you manage branding, retail prices, promotion, and customer support.

dujiao.title: Already use Dujiao
dujiao.text: Connect through the Dujiao OpenAPI. After syncing products, your store sets its own retail prices and upstream orders are deducted from your purchasing balance.

acg.title: Already use ACG
acg.text: Connect through ACG SharedStock. Both the current and legacy plugin paths are supported and share the same purchasing wallet.

preparation.title: Complete these steps first
preparation.description: The same API Key and API Secret use one purchasing wallet across both protocols; they do not create duplicate balances or duplicate orders.

steps.1: Register and sign in with your purchasing account on this site.
steps.2: Top up your purchasing balance. API orders use this balance and never charge your end customer's payment method directly.
steps.3: Open Personal Center → API Integration and submit an API credential application.
steps.4: After approval, save your API Key. The API Secret is shown only once and must be regenerated if lost.
steps.5: Test the connection first, then sync categories, products, SKUs, prices, and inventory.
steps.6: Use only your own test account for one minimum-value order. Verify deduction, delivery, lookup, and idempotency before opening sales.

preparation.secretWarningStrong: Never send a real API Secret to any AI or third party.
preparation.secretWarningBody: You may share this guide with an AI, but enter credentials only in your own server configuration.

dujiao.title: Dujiao / Dujiao-Next
dujiao.intro: In your downstream admin panel, open Integration Management → Connection Management → Add, then enter the fields below.

fields.callbackValue: The HTTPS callback URL generated by your downstream store

acg.title: ACG Card Store
acg.intro: Add a Store Share connection in the ACG admin panel. Prefer the current SharedStock integration; choose the SharedStock plugin on older installations. This site supports both paths.

fields.apiTypeValue: Current SharedStock; use the SharedStock plugin on legacy stores

acg.signingRules:
1. Include app_id, app_key, and all business fields in the form
2. Remove sign and ignore empty values
3. Sort fields by name in ascending order
4. Join them as key=value&key=value
5. Append &key=APP_KEY
6. Calculate the lowercase MD5 of the complete string

1.title: Order IDs are permanently unique
1.text: Dujiao uses downstream_order_no; SharedStock uses request_no. Always reuse the original ID for the same purchase.

2.title: Query before retrying an unknown result
2.text: A timeout or processing status is not a failure. Query the original order first; never place another order under a new ID.

3.title: Insufficient balance means no purchase
3.text: The upstream purchase is not created when the downstream balance is insufficient. After topping up, retry under the original business ID as the protocol requires.

4.title: Treat order status as the delivery source of truth
4.text: Save any delivered key or content to your own order. If a callback fails, compensate by polling the order query endpoint.

ai.title: Give this prompt directly to your AI
ai.description: It contains no real credentials. After the AI changes the code, test connection, catalog, and idempotency in a test environment first.
ai.prompt:
Integrate my card-store system with Laoshiren AI Partner. Read and follow the contract below, inspect the existing project type, propose the smallest viable change, implement it, and run tests. Never ask for or output a real API Secret.

Upstream base URL: {siteBase}
Credential placeholders: YOUR_API_KEY / YOUR_API_SECRET

If the project is Dujiao-Next:
1. Use the Dujiao OpenAPI.
2. Send these headers: Dujiao-Next-Api-Key, Dujiao-Next-Timestamp, and Dujiao-Next-Signature.
3. Set body_md5=MD5(raw body). Build the signing text as METHOD + "\n" + PATH + "\n" + timestamp + "\n" + body_md5. Sign it with the API Secret using HMAC-SHA256 and output lowercase hexadecimal.
4. Endpoints: POST /api/v1/upstream/ping; GET /api/v1/upstream/categories; GET /api/v1/upstream/products; GET /api/v1/upstream/products/:id; POST /api/v1/upstream/orders; GET /api/v1/upstream/orders/:id; POST /api/v1/upstream/orders/:id/cancel.
5. Every created order must include a permanently unique downstream_order_no. On timeout, query the original order first and never retry under a different ID.

If the project is ACG:
1. Prefer the current SharedStock endpoints: /shared/authentication/connect, /shared/commodity/items, /shared/commodity/item, /shared/commodity/inventory, /shared/commodity/inventoryState, /shared/commodity/valuation, /shared/commodity/trade, and /shared/commodity/query.
2. Legacy compatibility prefix: /plugin/SharedStock/api/*.
3. Use application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Include app_id=YOUR_API_KEY, app_key=YOUR_API_SECRET, and the business fields.
4. For the signature, remove sign, ignore empty values, sort fields by name in ascending order, join them as key=value&key=value, append &key=YOUR_API_SECRET, and calculate the lowercase MD5.
5. trade must include a permanently unique request_no. If the result is processing or the request times out, query or retry with the same request_no; never generate a new one.

Shared requirements:
- The downstream system uses a prepaid purchasing balance. Do not create an upstream purchase when the balance is insufficient.
- Save the upstream order number, status, and delivery content. If callbacks fail, compensate with polling through the query endpoint.
- Handle delisted products, insufficient inventory, insufficient balance, and unknown results as separate states.
- Test connection, catalog, SKU mapping, inventory, valuation, balance deduction, delivery, lookup, and idempotency.
- Report the changed files, configuration items, test results, and any real-funds path that remains unverified.

items.1: Use HTTPS in production and keep the server clock accurate.
items.2: Store the API Secret only in server-side secret management, never in frontend code or chat.
items.3: Test connection, catalog, inventory, valuation, order creation, lookup, and duplicate requests.
items.4: Verify that one business ID deducts the balance once and creates only one upstream purchase.
items.5: Alert on insufficient balance, delisted products, insufficient inventory, and upstream timeouts.
items.6: Reconcile orders, wallet entries, upstream purchases, and deliveries every day.

integrationGuide.guideText:
Laoshiren AI Partner Integration Guide

Site URL: {siteBase}

1. Preparation
1. Register a purchasing account and top up its balance.
2. Apply for API credentials in Personal Center. After approval, save the API Key and API Secret.
3. Never send the API Secret to an AI or third party; configure it only on your own server.

2. Dujiao / Dujiao-Next
Protocol: Dujiao OpenAPI
Site URL: {siteBase}
API Key: YOUR_API_KEY
API Secret: YOUR_API_SECRET
After connecting, sync categories, products, and SKUs, then place a minimum-value order using your own test account.

3. ACG
Store URL: {siteBase}
API type: Prefer the current SharedStock integration; legacy stores can use the SharedStock plugin
Merchant ID: YOUR_API_KEY
App Key: YOUR_API_SECRET
This site supports both /shared/* and /plugin/SharedStock/api/*.

4. Mandatory rules
- downstream_order_no / request_no must be permanently unique.
- On timeout or an unknown result, query the original order first; never repurchase under a new ID.
- Do not purchase when the balance is insufficient; all API orders settle against the purchasing balance.
- Before opening sales, verify deduction, delivery, lookup, and idempotency.
